Detects Next.js page with __NEXT_DATA__ but no rendered content as needing JS rendering

```swift title="Swift"
import Crawlberg

let engineConfig = try crawlConfigFromJson("{\"browser\":{\"mode\":\"never\"}}")
let engineObj = try createEngine(config: engineConfig)
let url = "https://example.com"
let result = try await Crawlberg.scrape(engine: engineObj, url: url)
debugPrint(result.statusCode())
debugPrint(result.jsRenderHint())
debugPrint(result.browserUsed())
```
